news.title: Chinese auto giant Geely to enter Cyprus car market in 2026 with three models

summary: Geely Auto Europe is create mobility experiences that exceed expectations.. Type: listed company. About 52 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: The European arm of Chinese car maker Geely, with marketing and operations internships in Amsterdam that draw lots of applicants.

culture.text: Staff often studied international business, English, economics or journalism, at schools like HAN, The Hague UAS and King's College London.
Current openings are two internships in Amsterdam, in operations and marketing.

open.text: Both current internships are open to non-Dutch speakers.
It is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Geely plans to enter the Cyprus car market in 2026 with three models.

worth_knowing.text: Its LinkedIn postings get about 158 applicants on average, so expect competition.
